name: Takamura Haruka
source:
University student. The protagonist's step sister.

She has a gentle and soft personality. Stepdaughter of her step mother, she is not related to the main character.

She is well-behaved, kind, and teaches the protagonist to become a respectable adult. She excels in her studies and is enthusiastic about volunteer work and other community service activities.

[From [url=https://www.miel-soft.com/gibotogiane.html]official site[/url]]
